title: consensusRegions 0.99.0
text: First release, submitted Bioconductor. buildConsensus() combines evidence overlapping peaks across replicates, following approach MSPC: two p-value thresholds, minimum number supporting replicates, test combined statistic, Benjamini-Hochberg correction inside replicate. Four combination schemes. Fisher reproduces original behaviour; Stouffer Lancaster accept per-replicate weights; rank product works ranks alone needs p-values. computeReplicateWeights() derives weights BAM files, FRiP values measured elsewhere, peak sets neither available. calibrateThreshold() estimates threshold combined statistic shuffled peak sets rather leaving fixed 1e-8. Input degrades gracefully. narrowPeak p-values used directly, plain score column rank-transformed, BED3 input falls back weighted k--n presence rule. recentrePeaks() recovers summits returns fixed-width regions, motif analysis count matrices want. plotRescue(), plotJaccard(), plotUpset() plotCalibration() quality control; asSummarizedExperiment() hand consensus csaw, DiffBind edgeR.
